name: [W10] Rope Swing Obby
desc:
Warning: Controls may be hard to get used to.

Test your skills in this high-flying obby, where ropes are your only way to parkour through thrilling adventures! Swing, jump, and soar through challenging obstacle courses that will push your precision to the limit.

--------- Benefits:
🎁Join the group for up to 100% extra crates rewards and 1 free daily skip!
🌟Premium players will have access to Premium crates, 100% chance to get 100% extra rewards from Premium crates, and an extra daily free skip!

--------- Latest (USE PRIVATE SERVERS FOR LASTEST UPDATES)
+🎄Winter World 2
+🛠️Fixed leaderboards not updating
+📦Fixed W10 not accessible to W8

--------- Console Controls 🎮:
□/X replaces Q
△/Y replaces E

--------- And Lastly: Please leave a like 👍 if you enjoyed the game! It would be a huge motivation for me!
